output.brief: The fall in confirmed incidents is not real. Real attacks reaching analysts are about the same as before (37 in September, 36 in October, against a normal of about 38). The drop comes from cases being moved out of the "Confirmed" category after an analyst had already confirmed them. That was done by a script run from Brackwater's analyst computer, not by the platform connector, so it looks deliberate rather than a software fault. All 47 moved cases were moved just before the 4-hour SLA deadline and have no containment record, which also made the containment figures look better. Intent is not yet proven, but the pattern is clear enough to act on. Next steps: do not sign off the IR retainer cut or the Brackwater renewal bonus. Reinstate the 47 cases as confirmed incidents and have your own team verify containment. Remove category-edit rights from the Brackwater integration role. Ask Brackwater in writing to explain the script and the queue growth before any January decision. Hold the service credits until verified.
